title: Substitute Task Parameters
description: Progress from an intuitive model to the source implementation and its operational boundary: Substitute Task Parameters.
learning_objectives: Explain substitute task parameters using a plain-language model
Trace the source implementation for substitute task parameters
Assess failure and operational limits of substitute task parameters
concepts_covered: Parameters are placeholders replaced with values before commands run; missing values should fail rather than leave holes.
Substitute replaces $(params.name) and returns an error for absent parameters.
practical_outcomes: Explain at least one operational boundary
completion_criteria: Complete all three lessons and exercise
Score at least 7/10 on the assessment
